content.short: Hyperion is a high-performance hybrid Orderbook-AMM DEX on Aptos featuring concentrated liquidity and yield vaults.
content.description: Hyperion is a professional-grade decentralized exchange built natively on Aptos, utilizing a hybrid Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) and AMM architecture. This dual model combines the precision of traditional order books with the accessibility of automated market makers, allowing for efficient trade execution and minimal slippage. Leveraging Aptos's high throughput, Hyperion provides a high-performance trading environment with sub-second finality. In addition to core exchange features, Hyperion offers concentrated liquidity and automated yield vaults to maximize capital efficiency.
